newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STOCKS MIXED, INDEX EASES SLIGHTLY.
newsitem.headline: STOCKS MIXED, INDEX EASES SLIGHTLY.

text.p: Higher profit forecasts from
market leader Hansapank and free list stock Norma failed to
stop shares easing further in early Tuesday trade, a trend seen
continuing into August, dealers said.
"The main news item was Hansapank's revised profit forecast,
but this is already over and done with," one trader said.
Prices were stable to lower during morning trade and dealers
saw this as the start of a trend for next month.
"This looks like the start of a slow downward trend for
August," a trader said.
Hansapank led in the morning with 16.7 million kroons traded
at a spread of 190/191 against Monday's close of 192.50 kroons.
It earlier released a revised profit forecast for the group
of 475 million kroons from 320 million kroons and 380 million
kroons from 256 million for the bank's activities.
"It was an expected figure with nothing surprising about
it," one dealer said.
On the free market, Norma, a car seat belt manufacturer,
was the most active in trade of 1.9 mln kroons and stable at
89.50/90 kroons from 90 kroons.
Norma also released a revised profit estimate for 1997,
raising its forecast from 50.2 million kroons to 97.1 million
kroons.
"Norma was already doing well yesterday when it reached 90
kroons, so the market was not surprised by the revision and
really had no where to go," another dealer said.
